queries_run: Johnson Controls data center liquid cooling competition disruption 2026

findings.claim: JCI 10-K 風險因子：若無法敏捷回應新產品/技術（能效、液冷、AI/ML）的顛覆，業務與財務可能受不利影響
findings.excerpt: If we are unable to be agile and responsive to disruption in the development of new products, services and technologies, including capabilities such as energy efficiency, cooling technology (including liquid 11 cooling), artificial intelligence and machine learning, our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows could be adversely affected.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋僅得投資評論類來源（webull 等，提及 2026-01 Nvidia 稱下一代晶片可能降低資料中心冷卻需求、競爭加劇），無可逐字複製原文，未列入 findings。

clues.claim: Nvidia CEO 於 2026 年 1 月稱次世代晶片可能大幅降低資料中心冷卻需求；資料中心占 JCI 銷售比重有限
